task: plan v2 Task 8 -- does the ancestry-aware sampler (Task 6, commit 3e871e3) materially change what the canonical recipe learns?
why: The shipped sampler scores same-depth draws against the ANCHOR with no ancestry check: 47.375240% of draws are false negatives (results/negative_sampler_audit.json). Methods describe a clean Nickel-Kiela softmax. The manuscript must say either 'the fix materially changes the result' (shipped artifact trained on a defective objective; retrain scoped) or 'robust to the fix' (a reportable robustness result).

declared_confounds: The fixed arm drops root-anchored pairs (5.1505% of the full closure) from each epoch, so it takes ~5% fewer optimizer steps per epoch.

Where no valid same-depth negative exists (14.1446% of pairs over the full closure, fewer once root pairs are dropped), the fixed arm draws from outside the anchor's subtree at ANY depth -- easier negatives than the same-depth design. Rows affected are logged per epoch ('zero-pool rows').
Unfixed and fixed arms run in different LRZ src trees (src vs src_task8) at different times, possibly on different GPUs of the same partition; the default sampler path is hash-pinned identical.

metrics.primary: S_angle at k=10 (src/taxembed/eval/angular.py), same 10,000 queries seed 0 as Task 9, per run = mean over rolling epoch 196-200 checkpoints
secondary: S_angle by depth band and clade (clade level from choose_clade_level)
depth-norm r beside its metazoa init floor 0.984167
final-phase training loss (NOT comparable across arms: the fixed arm's softmax denominator has no false negatives)
per-epoch observed FN rate and zero-pool rows from the fixed arm's log

validity_gate: Same as preregistration_v2_20260922 in results/recipe_angular_comparison.json: (a) max_t S_angle(t) - S_angle(init) > 10 x within-run jitter SD; (b) final-phase (epoch >= 130) loss falls by more than its within-run jitter. Either failing => UNINFORMATIVE.

readings.MATERIAL: all 3 fixed seeds on one side of all 3 unfixed seeds on S_angle AND |mean difference| >= max(0.01, 2 x pooled within-arm seed SD) AND the same sign in every depth band and every clade stratum with n >= 500. Report the direction. If fixed > unfixed: the shipped artifact under-learned because of the defect; Methods must say so and a cellular retrain with the fix is scoped. If fixed < unfixed: report it; the false negatives were acting as a regularizer or the depth-relaxed negatives are too easy -- investigate before any retrain.
readings.ROBUST: 3v3 ranges overlap OR |mean difference| < max(0.01, 2 x pooled seed SD) => the defect does not materially change learned structure at this scale. Methods still states the deviation (C1) and reports this as a robustness result.
readings.MIXED: anything else (e.g. seed-separated aggregate whose sign flips in a stratum) -- reported per stratum, no aggregate claim.
